prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D platform game enemy sprite sheet. Create an original mischievous little GRAND PIANO IMP for a bright pastel fantasy Piano Kingdom with cream palaces and lavender clouds. A squat midnight-plum grand piano shaped creature, clearly visible ivory-and-black keyboard across its front, a small curved piano lid as its head crest, two lively golden eyes above the keyboard, rosy cheeks, lavender mitten hands and short golden feet. RIGHT FACING three-quarter side view, whole body, charming cheeky personality, hand-painted storybook gouache with soft texture and crisp plum outlines, cream, plum, lilac and gold. EXACTLY EIGHT isolated poses of the SAME character in a uniform FOUR columns by TWO rows grid. Generous fully transparent gutters, every whole character inside its own cell, consistent character scale. Reading order: 1 calm idle; 2 idle blink; 3 walking stride A; 4 walking stride B; 5 attack warning both hands lifted over its keyboard with determined anticipation; 6 attack slapping its keyboard energetically to launch a bouncing musical note, WITHOUT separate projectiles or floating icons; 7 tired recovering hands down and eyes half closed; 8 defeated seated squat, spiral eyes, piano still intact and cute. Keep entire feet, hands and lid visible inside every cell, all poses face RIGHT. Real transparent alpha background, no background, no floor, no external shadow, no glow, no text, no labels, no grid borders, no checkerboard, no other objects. Usable game animation art, not a poster.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D platformer enemy sprite sheet. Its compact upright body is an elegant warm walnut wooden triangular mechanical metronome, with a pair of large expressive owl eyes near the top, small lavender-feather wings as arms and tiny golden owl feet. A brass swinging pendulum and round gold weight are clearly attached to the FRONT of its body, like a belly clock. Tiny plum ear tufts, cream facial mask, warm gold details. Scholarly strict timekeeper personality, comical rather than scary. RIGHT FACING three-quarter side view, soft hand-painted gouache/cartoon texture, crisp brown-plum outlines, walnut, cream, lilac and gold. EXACTLY EIGHT isolated FULL body poses of the SAME owl in an equal FOUR columns by TWO rows grid with large transparent gutters and same body scale. Reading order: 1 idle pendulum centered; 2 idle blink; 3 walk A; 4 walk B; 5 warning raises one wing as a conductor and draws the attached pendulum to one side; 6 attack swings the attached pendulum outward on a SHORT arc, still entirely inside its cell; 7 recovery drooped wing and pendulum centered; 8 defeated seated owl with spiral eyes and feet forward, metronome still intact. All poses RIGHT facing. All pendulum parts, wings and feet wholly visible and safely within cell boundaries. Actual transparent background, no floor, no shadow outside silhouette, no glow, no scenery, no musical-note decorations, no other objects, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no checkerboard. Practical clean game sprites, not a poster.

Change ONLY the sheet layout: make EVERY character 20 percent smaller within its own equal grid cell, with very generous completely transparent gutters on ALL sides. FOUR columns x TWO rows still. Repair the small clipped hand at the far right of the fourth pose; ALL hands, feet and lid tips must be complete. Keep a stable body scale across all eight poses. Clear actual transparent alpha. No extra characters, text, background, glow, ground or shadow. This is a clean isolated sprite sheet for automatic slicing.
